purpose: Local manual compatibility and CopperStart/native Kickstart A/B exploration. Acquisition is not compatibility evidence.

applications.name: ProTracker
applications.rights: Author-provided free download; no explicit redistribution licence found in this binary archive. Keep original; do not infer the desktop pt2-clone licence.
applications.requirements: Verified on PAL OCS 68000, 512 KiB Chip + 512 KiB slow. Both main editors and selected inputs are observed; see latestVerification for the exact development ROM and scope.
applications.scenario: Create a short four-channel pattern with a generated/owned sample; play, stop, edit loop points, switch disk operations, then repeat from cold boot. Capture PCM, pattern position, GUI and saved MOD if writes are admitted.

observation.limit: No sample/module playback or save/readback tested.
observation.machine: PAL OCS 68000, 512 KiB Chip + 512 KiB slow

pairedObservation.limits: No sample/module playback or save/readback qualification.
pairedObservation.qualification: Development diagnostic only; app firmware pin unchanged

latestVerification.scope: Main editor, note pattern, play/stop and mouse parity. Not full application qualification.

latestRegression.scope: Main editor and pattern/play-stop regression; no nonempty sample playback or disk-write qualification.

applications.name: X-Copy
applications.rights: Private non-commercial use only; no commercial/government use; unchanged files may be distributed only entirely free of charge, never bundled with paid products.
applications.requirements: A500 candidate from authorised original master ADF. Begin with read/check operations. Cyclone external hardware is a separate unsupported prerequisite.
applications.scenario: Boot and check a known generated standard DD disk; seek/read both sides, report sectors and errors. Copy/format requires a separate admitted writable disposable target and drive configuration.

observation.limit: No disk check/copy/format or Cyclone hardware operation tested.
observation.machine: PAL OCS 68000, 512 KiB Chip + 512 KiB slow

pairedObservation.limits: No disk read/check sweep, copying, formatting or Cyclone hardware test.
pairedObservation.qualification: Development diagnostic only; app firmware pin unchanged

latestVerification.limits: Development ROM; app pin unchanged. Main screen only; disk checks/copy/format and Cyclone remain unverified.

applications.name: Amiga Test Kit
applications.rights: Upstream source is public domain / Unlicense.
applications.requirements: Bootable ADF and guest executable included. Begin on the bounded A500 machine; external peripherals require separate fixtures.
applications.scenario: Exercise video test cards, audio channels, memory, keyboard, mouse/joystick and CIA tests. Record individual subtest outcomes. Hardware takeover limits OS-API coverage.

observation.limit: Static-label rendering anomaly during toggles remains unresolved. No full test suite or hardware reference.
observation.machine: PAL OCS 68000, 512 KiB Chip + 512 KiB slow

pairedObservation.limits: Static labels disappear in both ROM runs; no full test suite or physical reference.
pairedObservation.qualification: Development diagnostic only; app firmware pin unchanged

latestVerification.scope: Main menu, individual channel mute and F7 restore; earlier missing-label interpretation contradicted by raw pixels. No full subtest suite.

applications.name: SysInfo
applications.rights: Donation-supported distribution; no-profit redistribution with unchanged documentation/icons. Supplied official ADF has its own bundled components; keep it intact.
applications.requirements: Classic 68k and Kickstart 1.x candidate; no FPU in the A500 pair. Keep the official ADF separate from a controlled executable installation.
applications.scenario: Inspect CPU/chipset, memory and library/device enumeration; scroll before and after speed test and quit/relaunch. Treat reported speed as guest behaviour, not host acceptance throughput.

observation.machine: PAL OCS 68000, 512 KiB Chip + 512 KiB slow

pairedObservation.qualification: Development diagnostic only; app firmware pin unchanged

applications.name: PPMore
applications.rights: Freeware for non-commercial use; preserve documentation. Coverdisk/diskmagazine distribution of PowerPacker utilities/libraries requires permission.
applications.requirements: Older AmigaOS candidate; reqtools.library and powerpacker.library required and absent from this archive. PPShow includes versions, but compatibility with this older viewer is unverified.
applications.scenario: Load fixed ASCII text, page/scroll/search, resize the window, open/cancel requester and quit/relaunch. Pin the two library versions before A/B.

applications.name: Personal Paint
applications.rights: Private, non-commercial, non-profit use only; archive publication/redistribution requires prior written licence from Cloanto or A-EON.
applications.requirements: Included manual section 1.2: at least 2 MiB RAM, preferably 1 MiB Chip; Kickstart 1.2+ with Workbench 1.3 libraries. Outside the qualified 1 MiB A500 CopperStart profile.
applications.scenario: Draw/fill, select/copy/rotate brush, change palette, undo/redo, open/cancel requester, load and save an original ILBM and reopen after cold boot. Record hardware blitter versus software blitter settings.

applications.name: PPShow
applications.rights: Non-commercial freeware; preserve the complete unmodified distribution.
applications.requirements: Kickstart and Workbench 2.0+; bundled reqtools.library and powerpacker.library. DataTypes optional on supporting OS.
applications.scenario: Show an original ILBM, cycle palette and play a small generated ANIM5. Test requester cancellation and return to desktop; do not require DataTypes for the initial case.

applications.name: DiskMaster 2
applications.rights: No-profit distribution of complete package; PD collectors/magazines require permission. Keep as local testing input.
applications.requirements: Readme says Kickstart V37+; Aminet Architecture field says AmigaOS >=2.1. Verify exact guest libraries before choosing an OS 2.04 reference. ReqTools required.
applications.scenario: List two directories, sort, create/rename/copy/delete original scratch files, cancel requesters and reopen. Compare file bytes and directory state after a cold reboot.

applications.name: MuchMore
applications.rights: Non-commercial use; commercial use/distribution requires author's written permission. Preserve author credit.
applications.requirements: AmigaOS 2.04+; optional XPK support needs its libraries. Start with plain text. Included WBInfo helper requires Kickstart 3.0+.
applications.scenario: Open deterministic long plain text, soft-scroll, search, change font/style, reopen requester and quit. Exercise window redraw while another window overlaps.

applications.name: MemCheck
applications.rights: Freely distributable; bundling with commercial software requires written permission.
applications.requirements: Kickstart 2.04+; destructive memory subtests should run in a disposable guest session.
applications.scenario: Run allocated-memory test first, record tested address ranges and error counts. Segment test writes across memory segments; use a fresh guest and reset afterwards.

applications.name: Amiga LhA
applications.rights: Included manual releases the complete version free with no registration required; retain original archive and manual.
applications.requirements: Kickstart 2.0+ per included manual; >=512 KiB RAM, 1 MiB recommended. Choose lha_68k for 68000; lha.run is an Amiga self-extractor, not a Windows program.
applications.scenario: List/test/extract a small owned archive, create another from known scratch files, extract on a fresh boot and compare file bytes, names and protection bits. Use a bounded buffer size.

applications.name: DeluxePaint V demo
applications.rights: EA readme explicitly allows free distribution of this demo, excluding commercial distribution. This is not the full commercial application.
applications.requirements: Guest OS/RAM prerequisites need verification. Readme specifies floppy use and required root Libs/Fonts; do not assume an HDF installation works. Non-AGA low-res 16-colour mode is provided.
applications.scenario: Draw/fill and use brushes/palette in supported low-res mode, load provided artwork, open/cancel menus/requesters. Save, Print, Delete and Copy are disabled by design; do not score them as emulator failures.
